author: fwyzard
body:
#### PR description:

Optimise filling the per-path resources in the `FastTimerService`:
  - sum the path resources in one pass after all Paths and EndPaths have run, instead of after each path;
  - skip the per-path DQM loop when `enableDQMbyPath` is not set.


#### PR validation:

Unit test pass.
title: FastTimerService: optimise filling per-path resources
